US Mortgage Rates Approach 7%, Highest Since Trump Era

US mortgage rates have climbed to nearly 7%, marking the highest level since the Trump administration. This increase has led to significant concern among potential homebuyers, with one individual expressing feelings of despondency. The rising rates impact the affordability of housing for many Americans.
